classification.difficultyReason: Read three labelled bags as 3p, count the removed and remaining lollies, and identify p as the quantity in one bag; the diagram supplies the operations.

spec.sourceRegion: Question 2 shared horizontal lolly-bag model above parts a and b
spec.description: Three equal bags labelled p, minus eight individual lollies in two rows of four, equals nineteen individual lollies arranged as nine above ten.
spec.mathematics: Three bags each contain p lollies. Removing eight lollies leaves nineteen: 3p - 8 = 19.
spec.answerVisibility: The bags, p labels, individual lollies and operation signs are permanent givens. The equation and variable definition belong only to the answers.

children.label: a
children.prompt: Write an equation describing this scenario.

answer.worked:
Three bags contain $3p$ lollies. Taking out 8 leaves 19.
$$3p - 8 = 19$$

answer.short: Number of lollies in each bag.
answer.worked: $p$ represents the number of lollies in each bag; three bags therefore contain $3p$ lollies.
